tools.name: tool_api__bakers_comment_publish
tools.title: Publish a ticket comment
tools.description: Stores a Markdown comment of the given type (plan, spec, summary, …) on a ticket. The create response is the confirmation.

type.description: The bb_comment_type, e.g. comment, plan, spec, test, acceptance, summary, qualification.
type.title: Comment type

body.description: Markdown source; raw HTML is stripped.
body.title: Body

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_conductor_list
tools.title: List conductors
tools.description: Lists the conductors of one readable project by label, with whether each is active and online. Assign one to a ticket with bakers_ticket_update.

conductors.description: The viewable conductors of this page.

uuid.description: The conductor UUID, as bakers_ticket_update takes it.
uuid.title: UUID

active.description: Whether the conductor can be assigned and claims work.
active.title: Active

conductors.title: Conductors

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null on the last page.

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_group_create
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: Creates a group in a workspace and returns it.

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_group_list
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: Lists the groups of a workspace by name, or the one group with the given UUID.

group.description: Group UUID, to read back one group.
group.title: Group

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null on the last page.

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_metric_write
tools.title: Record a measurement
tools.description: Replaces the ticket’s metric rows whose name starts with the definition name and a dot with the given rows, keeping every other row and label, and optionally adds a label by name (created in the ticket’s workspace when missing).

name.description: The measurement definition id, e.g. review_quality; every row name starts with it and a dot.
name.title: Measurement

unit.description: The unit, e.g. ratio or hours.
unit.title: Unit

label.description: A label name to add to the ticket, e.g. retro.
label.title: Label

metrics.description: Every metric row of the ticket after the write.
metrics.title: Metrics

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_project_create
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: Creates a project in a group for one or more teams of the same workspace; the key derives from the name and the ticket counter starts at 1. Returns the saved project.

group.description: UUID of the group that owns the project.
group.title: Group

name.description: The project name; the key, e.g. BAKERS, derives from it.
name.title: Name

teams.description: UUIDs of the teams the project belongs to, at least one, all of the group’s workspace.
teams.title: Teams

url.description: The clone URL, HTTPS or SSH.
url.title: URL

default_branch.description: The branch work bases on; main when omitted.
default_branch.title: Default branch

coder_config.description: The coder configuration map, stored as given.
coder_config.title: Coder config

key.description: The ticket identifier prefix, e.g. BAKERS.
key.title: Key

teams.description: The UUIDs of the project’s teams.
teams.title: Teams

default_branch.description: The default branch; null means main.
default_branch.title: Default branch

repository.description: The repository; null when unset or not viewable.
repository.title: Repository

coder_config.description: The coder configuration map; null when unset or not viewable.
coder_config.title: Coder config

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_project_read
tools.title: Read a project
tools.description: Returns one readable project by key or UUID: name, description, group, teams, repository and coder config. Environment variables are never returned.

key.description: The ticket identifier prefix, e.g. BAKERS.
key.title: Key

teams.description: The UUIDs of the project’s teams.
teams.title: Teams

default_branch.description: The default branch; null means main.
default_branch.title: Default branch

repository.description: The repository; null when unset or not viewable.
repository.title: Repository

coder_config.description: The coder configuration map; null when unset or not viewable.
coder_config.title: Coder config

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_team_list
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: Lists the teams of a workspace by name.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
next_offset.title: Next offset

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_classify
tools.title: Classify a ticket
tools.description: Sets a ticket’s recipe and/or type by term name of its workspace, created there when missing and the caller may. Returns the saved names.

type.description: Ticket type name, e.g. feature or bug.
type.title: Type

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_create
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Creates a ticket in a project, in its workflow’s initial state. Type and recipe are term names of the project’s workspace, created there when missing and the caller may. Returns the new ticket’s UUID, identifier and state.

description.description: Markdown source; raw HTML is stripped.
description.title: Description

type.description: Ticket type name, e.g. feature or bug.
type.title: Type

parent.description: Parent ticket identifier or UUID, in the same project.
parent.title: Parent

branch_name.description: Git branch for a carrier ticket, e.g. release/1.2; omit to derive it from the identifier and title. Fixed after creation.
branch_name.title: Branch name

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_read
tools.title: Read a ticket
tools.description: Returns a ticket’s fields, labels, links and its readable comments in chronological order.

base_branch.description: The branch the ticket’s work is based on.
base_branch.title: Base branch

frozen.description: Whether the ticket is frozen for a release batch.
frozen.title: Frozen

metrics.description: The ticket’s metric rows; null when not readable.
metrics.title: Metrics

type.description: The comment type, e.g. plan or spec.
type.title: Type

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_runs_list
tools.title: List ticket runs
tools.description: Lists the runs of a ticket you can view, newest first: state, the ticket state the run started in, agent, conductor, start time and whether the run is closed.

state.description: The run state, e.g. running or done.
state.title: State

state_at_start.description: The ticket state the run started in.
state_at_start.title: State at start

closed.description: Whether the run is fully wound up.
closed.title: Closed

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
next_offset.title: Next offset

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_search
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Finds up to 50 readable tickets whose title or description contains the query, or whose branch is exactly branch_name, newest first, optionally within one project. Each row names its branch, base branch and parent.

query.description: Text to find in ticket titles and descriptions.
query.title: Query

branch_name.description: Exact git branch of the ticket, e.g. feat/bakers-27-replace-the-pub.
branch_name.title: Branch name

base_branch.description: The branch the ticket’s work is based on.
base_branch.title: Base branch

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_template_run
tools.title: Run a ticket template
tools.description: Creates a new ticket from an enabled ticket template. Every call creates a ticket. Each given input replaces the template default; {{date}} and {{month}} in title and description are rendered. A workspace template needs a project. Returns the new ticket’s UUID and identifier.

description.description: Ticket description as Markdown; {{date}} and {{month}} are rendered.
description.title: Description

project.description: UUID of the project to create the ticket in; required for a workspace template.
project.title: Project

conductor.description: UUID of a conductor of the ticket’s project; empty clears the template’s conductor.
conductor.title: Conductor

labels.description: Label term UUIDs, replacing the template labels.
labels.title: Labels

target_state.description: State the new ticket is moved to; empty keeps the initial state.
target_state.title: Target state

identifier.description: The new ticket’s identifier, e.g. BAKERS-15.
identifier.title: Identifier

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_transition
tools.title: Transition a ticket
tools.description: Moves a ticket to the target state when its workflow allows it, appending the given links to the existing ones; without a state it only appends the links. Returns the saved state and links.

state.description: The workflow state id to move to, e.g. working or review; omit to only append links.
state.title: Target state

links.description: Links to add; existing links are kept and duplicates merged.

uri.description: The link target, e.g. a merge request URL.
uri.title: URI

links.title: Links

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_ticket_update
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Changes an open ticket’s title, description (Markdown, replaced whole), conductor, labels (added by name, existing ones kept) and/or frozen flag; fields left out keep their values. Setting a conductor dispatches a run on the ticket’s current state and fills an empty assignee with the conductor’s owner. Returns the saved values.

description.description: The new description as Markdown source; replaces the whole text, empty clears it. Raw HTML is stripped.
description.title: Description

conductor.description: UUID of an active conductor of the ticket’s project.
conductor.title: Conductor

labels_add.description: Label names to add, e.g. agent:claude; created in the ticket’s workspace when missing and allowed. Existing labels are kept.
labels_add.title: Labels to add

frozen.description: TRUE freezes the ticket for a release batch, FALSE unfreezes it.
frozen.title: Frozen

description.description: The saved description as Markdown source.
description.title: Description

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_time_propose
tools.title: Propose time
tools.description: Stores activities as proposed worklogs of one new proposed submission owned by the caller, for review in the week sheet. Any failing entry stores nothing; the message names it by 1-based position and source_key.

project.description: Project UUID used by entries that name none.
project.title: Project

account.description: Billing account UUID used by entries that name none; otherwise the project or ticket default applies.
account.title: Billing account

source_system.description: Where the activity comes from, e.g. git.
source_system.title: Source system

source_key.description: Stable key of the activity within its source system.
source_key.title: Source key

source_version.description: Version of the activity; a recorded key with other content is refused.
source_version.title: Source version

description.description: What was done, at most 2000 characters.
description.title: Description

project.description: Project UUID; defaults to the top-level project.
project.title: Project

account.description: Billing account UUID; defaults to the top-level account.
account.title: Billing account

items.description: One activity with stable source identity.
items.title: Entry

worklogs.description: One worklog per entry, in entry order.
worklogs.title: Worklog UUIDs

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_worklog_list
tools.title: List own worklogs
tools.description: Returns the caller’s own non-voided worklogs between two civil dates (at most 378 days), with the readable projects and tickets they reference. A reference the caller cannot read is null and sets omitted.

offset.description: Rows to skip; use next_offset of the previous page.
offset.title: Offset

data.description: The page, oldest first by creation.
data.title: Worklogs

project_id.description: Project UUID, or null when unreadable.
project_id.title: Project

omitted.description: TRUE when some referenced context is unreadable.
omitted.title: Omitted

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
next_offset.title: Next offset

tools.name: tool_api__bakers_workspace_list
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: Lists the workspaces you can view, by name.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or null on the last page.
next_offset.title: Next offset
